featured.name: Official Supporters Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
Greetings truckers!  

Are you ready for our next Supporters Convoy?  
Join us on our exclusive supporter-only convoy as we all come together to drive through the beautiful countryside of Germany, France & Belgium.
![Banner](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/8864dada-e7c5-4b13-8d3f-8c0f2dc0b630.avif)

Join us on **Saturday, 3rd October 2026**, at **17:00 UTC** **([Alternative Timezones](https://notime.zone/P-tLcOMoYAJV0))**.  

The convoy is expected to last around 90 minutes. While there won’t be any planned breaks or fuel stops along the way, feel free to pull over safely if you need to take a short break or refuel.
Feel free to comment or ask any questions in the [#patrons](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/609444023966498836) or [#supporters](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/586644869695406130) channel on our **[Discord](https://discord.gg/truckersmp)**!  

---

**This is a Patron, Nitro Booster, and Twitch Subscriber exclusive event**, which means you must have an active subscription to one of our Patreon tiers, be a Nitro Booster on our Discord, or have an active subscription to our Twitch channel.  
    
Please note that, to be eligible to join as a Twitch subscriber, **you must** be in our Discord with a connected TruckersMP account and have your Twitch account connected to your Discord profile. If you do not do this before the **1st October 2026**, you will not be able to participate.  

**Not a Patron yet, but want to participate?** It is not too late! Make sure you become one of our Patrons before the **1st October 2026**. Become a Patron **[here](https://www.patreon.com/bePatron?u=16310284)**.  

Don't forget to connect your Patreon account to your TruckersMP account. Not sure how to do this? **[Click here](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/598)**.  

**You can also subscribe to our Twitch channel [here](https://twitch.tv/truckersmp_official).**  
Don't know how to connect your Discord account? **[Click here](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/239)**.  

Note: If you boost our Discord before the 1st October 2026, you’re also eligible to participate!

Want to clip part of the convoy that you enjoy, or a funny moment? Download Medal.TV via our [affiliate link](https://ref.medal.tv/truckersmp) today!  

---

![Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/8e2b876b-4e51-487a-93ec-41f67bb41d19.avif)  

**Departure:** Mannheim, City

**Destination:** Liège, City

**DLC:** None

Don't forget to mark your attendance and review the event server rules on our **[event page](https://truckersmp.com/events/)**.

We look forward to seeing you there!

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

### 🌷 Orgin Event™ Petals on Wheels

We are proud to present **Orgin Event™ Petals on Wheels**, a special seasonal convoy celebrating the beauty of spring as we journey together through stunning scenic routes and blooming landscapes. Expect smooth driving, professional convoy management, and a memorable experience hosted by the Orgin Event™ team.

Get ready for a relaxing and well-organized ride filled with vibrant spring vibes, peaceful roads, and an amazing trucking community. This event is designed to deliver a realistic, enjoyable, and unforgettable convoy experience for every participant.

Whether you are joining with your VTC or as a public driver, everyone is warmly welcome to be part of this blooming journey on the road! 🌿

---

### 𝒊 EVENT DETAILS

➤  **Meetup Time:** 14:00pm UTC

➤  **Departure Time:** 15:00pm UTC

➤  **Server:** To be determined

➤  **Start Location:** TruckerMP HQ

upcoming.description:
##  蔷薇物流•庆祝新中国成立77周年联运活动:
活动目的：本次联运由蔷薇物流主办，“欢迎愿意前来参加的车队一同参与”我们以欧卡联运的形式共同庆祝新中国成立77周年，借此机会结识卡车爱好者，增进各车队车友之间的交流与友谊。

本次联运仅使用游戏本体地图，**不需要任何DLC**，所有玩家均可参与。
路线：汉堡 → 不莱梅 → 奥斯纳布吕克 → 杜伊斯堡 → 安特卫普 → 布鲁塞尔 → 里尔 → 加来(轮渡) → 多佛

⏰活动时间
活动日期：2026年10月3日
集合时间：19:30
发车时间：20:30
集合地点:汉堡车库集合

📸活动安排
全程编队统一行驶，抵达终点多佛港口进行集体合影，活动结束。


-----
# Rose Logistics • Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China:

Purpose: This convoy is hosted by Rose Logistics. Teams that are willing to come and join are welcome. We will celebrate the 77th anniversary of New China through an ETS2 convoy, meet trucking enthusiasts and build friendship between players from different teams.

This convoy uses only the base game map, **no DLC required**, all players are welcome.
Route: Hamburg → Bremen → Osnabrück → Duisburg → Antwerp → Brussels → Lille → Calais(Ferry) → Dover

⏰Schedule
Event date: 03 Oct 2026
Gather time: 11:30 UTC
Departure time: 12:30 UTC
Meeting point: Hamburg (AI Automotive) garage

📸Activity Plan
Drive in formation throughout the trip. Take a group photo at Dover Port when arriving at the destination, then the event ends.

upcoming.rule:
Event Rules for Participants:

Only Event Staff are able to use the following words or phrases in their player tag; "GCCC | Lead ", "GCCC | Tail", "GCCC | CC", "GCCC | Media", "GCCC | Supervisor", “GCCC | Manager”.
Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
Participants must haul a trailer. Except for Event Staff.
Advertising is prohibited. Except for Event Staff.
Cars and Busses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. Except for Event Staff.
Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park at the 'Public Parking'.
Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly manner.
Free-roaming on the server is strictly prohibited.
Overtaking on the server is prohibited.
All other [TruckersMP](https://truckersmp.com/rules) rules apply.


Event Staff Rules:

Media & Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
All other [TruckersMP](https://truckersmp.com/rules) rules apply.
